reviews.title: Pull request reviews
reviews.lede: agnts reviews the pull requests assigned to you on GitHub and GitLab. Merge from here when the review looks good, or dismiss it and review on the git host yourself.
reviews.synced: {open} waiting for you in {repos} repositories · {created} new · {rereview} reviewed again · {closed} ended
reviews.enabledHelp: Check the git host every 5 minutes and review new pull requests. When off, only Sync now does it.
reviews.reviewRequestedHelp: Also take pull requests whose review is requested from you, not only those assigned to you.
reviews.skipDraftsHelp: Leave draft pull requests alone until they are ready.
reviews.rereviewHelp: Review again when the author pushes while the review waits for you.
reviews.mergeMethodHelp: How agnts merges a pull request you accept.
reviews.emptyAll: No pull requests to review yet. Assign one to yourself on GitHub or GitLab, then press Sync now.
reviews.howSub: Notes you leave when you ask for another review or dismiss one are folded into your profile on the next review. Every later review reads it.
reviews.noReviewers: agnts knows nothing about how you review yet. Leave a note when you ask for another review, or add one below.
reviews.profileHint: Markdown: what you care about, what is noise, how severe you rate things.
reviews.folded: {n, plural, one {# note learned} other {# notes learned}}
reviews.notePlaceholder: For example: naming nits are noise to me; always check that migrations can be rolled back.
reviews.newCommits: New commits since agnts reviewed {sha}: it reviews them again
reviews.postConfirm: Post agnts's review of #{number} on {host} as a comment? It is posted as your {host} account and everyone on the pull request sees it.
reviews.posted: agnts's review of this commit is on {host} · {when}
reviews.queuedSub: agnts will fetch it and review it.
reviews.reviewingSub: agnts is reading the change. Its review appears here.
reviews.readySub: Merge it from here, review again with a note, or dismiss it and review on {host} yourself.
reviews.noteHint: Tell agnts what it got wrong or missed. The note also teaches it how you review.
reviews.mergeConfirm: agnts merges #{number} on {host} ({method}), at the commit it reviewed.
reviews.dismissReasonHint: Optional. It also teaches agnts how you review.
reviews.dismissConfirm: agnts stops reviewing #{number}. The pull request stays open on {host}.
reviews.dismissedSub: The pull request is yours on {host}.
reviews.reviewTitle: agnts's review of the pull request
